desc: save the configuration in json format into a file.
r: accel-config-save-config - save the configuration in json format into a file.

accel-config save-config [<options>]

Save the current configuration displayed in json format into a specified path with specified file name.
<dl><dt data-o="">-s, --saved-file=</dt><dd>to specify saved file name and path</dd></dl>
